test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Plastic inhabits the oceans, ______ up in the guts of seagulls and great white sharks.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1' i.e. 'Building'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank in the sentence* "Plastic inhabits the oceans, ______ up in the guts of seagulls and great white sharks."* is option 1) **'building'.**
 
• The verb **'building'** in this context means accumulating or gathering up.
 
• **It makes sense **because the plastic waste gradually accumulates in the bodies of marine creatures, such as seagulls and great white sharks, causing harm to them.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'Plastic inhabits the oceans, **building **up in the guts of seagulls and great white sharks.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's the explanation for each option:
 
 
• **'Burning'** refers to being on fire, which is not applicable in this context.
 
• **'Provoking'** means causing a reaction, usually a strong negative one, which doesn't make sense in this context.
 
• **'Sailing'** refers to the act of travel by water, and it doesn't fit this context as the plastic is not travelling but accumulating.
